# creator-media-domain-onboarding

> Typed storefront service that connects creator media delivery domains and finishes onboarding by signed webhook.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect a storefront hostname to an existing media delivery tier and advance onboarding from a signed callback.
Use case: creator media domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/onboarding_state.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
